title: SAP NetWeaver Enterprise Portal does not sufficiently protect certain server-side actions against… (CVE-2026-89131)
description: SAP NetWeaver Enterprise Portal contains a cross-site request forgery (CSRF) vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to craft a malicious link. When an authenticated user clicks this link, it can trigger unintended server-side actions that modify non-sensitive information. The vulnerability impacts integrity with no effect on confidentiality or availability. The CVSS score is 4.3, indicating a medium severity level.
